subject: Leaf Blower Ordinance
overview: The committee met to review a draft ordinance regulating leaf blower use in Medford and heard extensive testimony from city staff, local landscapers, and residents. The committee approved a consolidated package of eleven amendments to revise the draft and voted to keep the paper in committee.

items.title: Paper 21-057: Proposed Leaf Blower Ordinance
items.summary: Approved eleven policy amendments to align operating hours with the existing noise ordinance, remove municipal exemptions, eliminate decibel measuring requirements, permit electric blowers year-round, restrict seasonal gas-powered blower use, and implement commercial permitting fees. The committee then voted to keep the paper in committee while councilors redraft the text for legal review.
